title: Deeper/broader CADMPEG ACIS/ASM reader candidate and evidence-lineage update
mode: Primary-source project, release, crate, and local-plan review; research-only update
scope: Screen the CADMPEG bare SAT/SAB reader as a newly surfaced ACIS payload comparator
Separate direct payload decoding from DWG/DXF container and AcDs association evidence
Inspect explicitly documented verified and unverified save-format bands and open semantic items
Resolve parser, producer, corpus, and kernel correlation with the existing cq-acis candidate
Refine the optional PAR-07/S8 composed evidence checkpoint without changing local implementation order

sources.name: CADMPEG release v0.6.2
sources.observed: The GitHub releases page lists v0.6.2 at commit 7bcc952, published 2026-10-19, with checksummed platform release assets. The release page alone does not bind the SAT codec crate archive to the release binary or docs.rs artifact.

sources.name: CADMPEG repository and ACIS/ASM format support
sources.observed: The project has a distinct cadmpeg-asm and cadmpeg-codec-sat implementation path for bare ASM/ACIS streams. Its documented codec is read-only, produces a neutral model, and does not provide a DWG/DXF outer-container route. It identifies ASM BinaryFile4/8 and text streams separately and documents only ACIS save-format majors 217 and 218 as verified; other ACIS majors are unverified. The open-items document explicitly names unresolved grammar and semantic questions, including cache ownership, pcurve handling, body-kind inference, and topology substitution. The inspected repository workspace contains no declared cq-acis dependency, but this does not establish producer/corpus/author independence.

sources.name: CADMPEG release/crate artifact alignment
sources.observed: The GitHub release page lists v0.6.2 at commit 7bcc952 while the currently served docs.rs crate page identifies cadmpeg-codec-sat v0.6.1. Exact release, source tag, crate archive, and documentation-build alignment must be resolved and hashed before a run.

sources.name: cq-acis lineage disclosure
sources.observed: The existing source review records cq-acis as citing CADMPEG format notes/source for SAB grammar/layout work and using CadQuery/OpenCascade for conversion. CADMPEG and cq-acis can be distinct executable implementations but share format-discovery ancestry and cannot be counted as independent positive evidence without further provenance analysis.

sources.name: Local DWG/DXF parity plan
sources.observed: The plan already separates carrier extraction/association, ACIS payload decoding, independent geometric semantics, and native-consumer acceptance under PAR-07/S8. The new route belongs only as an optional direct-payload comparator in that existing lane.

assessment.planImpact: Adds an optional exact-pinned direct ACIS/ASM payload differential to existing PAR-07/S8. It is explicitly correlated with cq-acis in format-discovery ancestry, limited to verified branches, and non-promoting for DWG/DXF container, AcDs association, native acceptance, or support claims. An exact release/source/crate mismatch or intersecting open grammar item yields ARTIFACT_UNRESOLVED or OPEN_ITEM and does not block local implementation.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source research plus a focused crosswalk against the existing local parity plan
method.limitations: GitHub release/source pages and docs.rs may expose different publication snapshots. No exact v0.6.2 crate archive was obtained or run, no CADMPEG test specimen was independently reproduced, and no source/corpus provenance audit was performed beyond the public declarations and inspected workspace dependency list. Conclusions are candidate admission guidance, not format authority or semantic qualification.
